title: Wealth Engine — Data Schema
description: Reference documentation for the illustrative fixture data in js/data.js. It is not loaded at runtime and does not validate signed-in account data.

MonthLabel.description: Display label for one month, generated from the current month through the forecast horizon.

NairaAmount.description: A Nigerian Naira (₦) amount. Always a non-negative integer.

MonthlyArray.description: Month-specific schedule with up to 120 entries (the ten-year maximum). The selected forecast uses only its first 12 to 120 entries; missing entries are treated as zero. 0 = no payment that month.

salary.description: Monthly net salary after tax and pension deductions.

cola.description: Illustrative monthly allowance, in addition to net salary.

items.description: Display label shown in the UI and cash flow table.
Default monthly amount. User can override in the Edit Inputs tab.

VariableExpenses.description: Each key is a named expense stream; each value is a MonthlyArray.

loan_bundle.description: Combined monthly repayment for the two sample loans.

savings_goal_1.description: Contribution schedule for sample savings goal 1.

savings_goal_2.description: Contribution schedule for sample savings goal 2.

DebtStatus.description: active = being repaid normally; negotiating = settlement under review; settled = cleared.

name.description: Display name of the lender / loan.

balance.description: Current outstanding balance (update as payments are made).

opening.description: Opening balance at the start of the plan (used for progress bar denominator).

rate_pa.description: Annual interest rate in percent. 0 for flat-fee or informal debts.

monthly.description: Scheduled monthly repayment. 0 if lump-sum or under negotiation.

end.description: Expected payoff date or status string (e.g. 'Nov 2027', 'Pending').

note.description: Free-text note shown on the debt card.

SavingsGoalColor.description: Theme colour key used for the savings card accent and progress bar.

key.description: Key into VARIABLE, or '__rent__' to sum savings_goal_1 + savings_goal_2.

purpose.description: Short description of what this savings goal is for.

BrandPalette.description: Hex colour values used by Chart.js datasets. CSS variables for UI elements are in style.css :root.

FORECAST_YEARS.description: Default number of years in the rolling forecast. Signed-in users can choose 1–10 years; each account's selected horizon is stored with its plan.

MONTHS.description: Ordered month labels generated from the current month and selected forecast horizon.

NM.description: Derived from MONTHS.length. Do not edit manually.

OPENING_BALANCE.description: Illustrative fixture value for available cash at the start of the first forecast month; may be negative if already overdrawn.

PAYDAY.description: Usual monthly salary payment day; days beyond a month's end use that month's last day.

FIXED_DEF.description: Fixed monthly expenses. Keys are camelCase slugs used as DOM input IDs.

FIXED_DUE_DAYS.description: Usual monthly due day for each fixed expense. Days beyond a month's end use that month's last day.

VARIABLE_DUE_DAYS.description: Usual monthly due day for each variable expense stream. Days beyond a month's end use that month's last day.
